integrity: Proof is self-contained for all integer iteration counts and sketch widths. Standalone exact-rational finite tests provide reproducibility, not a substitute for proof. No independent audit or outside validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; real invertible 2-by-2 matrices with a strictly positive spectral gap; iid Rademacher entries; rank-revealing sketch and target-rank-one truncated SVD; expected squared Frobenius norm only. Widths above two are a defined redundant-column extension. Unindexed special-case priority remains a residual uncertainty.
title: A sharp orientation law for Rademacher subspace iteration on two-by-two matrices
